name: Heading

props.description: Độ đậm theo canon 3 bậc (400 · 500 · 700). Đặt `bold` cho tiêu đề cần nhấn.
props.name: weight

props.description: Heading level — sizes from --heading-h{1..4} and renders the matching <h*>.
props.name: level

props.description: Override the rendered element (e.g. a visual h2 that is a real <h1>).
props.name: as

tagline: Section heading sized from the --heading-h* tokens. `level` sets the size AND the semantic <h1..h4>.
usage: DO use `<Heading level>` for section titles instead of a raw `<h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">`. The level drives both the token size and the semantic element.
Inside a Card use `<CardTitle>`; use `<Heading>` for free-standing page/section headings not covered by a component slot.
useCases: A section heading on a dashboard: `<Heading level={3}>今月のKPI</Heading>`.
A visually-smaller heading that must stay an <h1> for a11y: `<Heading level={1} as="h1">…</Heading>`.
